title: Safe Copy Trade Processing
summary: EN: Build a runnable function that copies a trader's trade for one follower. | 中文: 需要实现一个可运行的 processCopyTrade 函数：当交易员开仓时，系统尝试为一个 follower 创建对应的跟单交易。
EN: The same trade may arrive again or arrive at the same time. | 中文: 最难的要求是同一笔交易可能因重试被发送多次，也可能有不同交易同时竞争同一个 follower 的余额和额度，结果必须始终一致。
EN: Show correct balances, allocation, and recorded trades in three cases. | 中文: 成功标准是在正常、重复发送、并发两笔交易这三个场景中，余额和剩余额度正确，且记录的跟单交易数量正确。

sections.title: Understanding
points: Copy one source trade for an eligible follower.
Check copying status, balance, and remaining allocation.
Deduct balance and allocation after a successful copy.
Record one follower trade for each source trade.
Handle retries and concurrent requests safely.
speakingNotes: 这一题是在实现一个小型跟单交易后端。当交易员开仓时，系统收到一笔 source trade，然后尝试为一个 follower 创建金额相同的跟单交易。我的实现只处理一个 trade 和一个 follower，但把真实系统里最重要的一致性问题保留下来。 ｜ This function receives one source trade and tries to copy it for one follower. I will focus on the state changes that must stay safe.

follower 不是总能跟单。只有 copyingEnabled 为真，并且 balance 和 remainingAllocation 都不少于 trade amount 时，才允许创建跟单。这里两个额度都要检查，因为它们代表不同的业务限制。 ｜ A follower is eligible only when copying is enabled and both the balance and the remaining allocation can cover the trade.

成功时必须同时完成三个结果：从 balance 扣掉金额，从 remainingAllocation 扣掉金额，并保存一条 copy trade 记录。不能只做其中两步，否则账户状态和交易记录会互相矛盾。 ｜ A successful copy has three results: reduce the balance, reduce the allocation, and record the copied trade. These results must agree.
题目特别强调同一请求可能重试，也可能有两个不同请求同时到达。普通的先检查再扣钱，在这两种情况下都可能重复扣款或超出额度，所以安全性是这道题的核心。 ｜ The main risks are retries and concurrent requests. A simple check followed by an update can charge twice or overspend.

我把 trade amount 限制为有限的正数，并假设这个服务负责维护 follower 的状态和跟单记录。先用一个可运行的内存 demo 证明行为，再说明多 worker 生产环境需要怎样升级。 ｜ I require a finite positive amount. I will first prove the behavior with a runnable in-memory demo, then explain the production version.

sections.title: Approach
points: Keep follower state and records in memory for this demo.
Use trade ID plus follower ID as one idempotency key.
Use one mutex lock for each follower.
Run checks and updates inside one critical section.
Return copied, duplicate, or rejected results.
speakingNotes: 为了让 demo 可以直接运行，我使用三个 in-memory Map：一个保存 follower 状态，一个保存已经成功的 copy trades，一个保存每个 follower 的等待锁。这不是生产数据库，而是把核心业务流程集中在一个容易检查的例子里。 ｜ I use in-memory maps for this demo: one for followers, one for recorded trades, and one for locks. This keeps the behavior easy to run and inspect.

我把 trade ID 和 follower ID 拼成 idempotency key，例如 trade-100:follower-1。因为同一笔 trade 给不同 follower 是两个不同操作，所以 key 必须同时包含这两个 ID。 ｜ I build an idempotency key from the trade ID and follower ID. The same source trade can be copied for many followers, so both IDs matter.

idempotency 的意思是同一个业务操作执行多次，最终金融效果仍然和执行一次相同。第一次请求成功后，后续重试应该返回已有结果，而不是再次扣余额或再写一条记录。 ｜ Idempotency means that repeating the same operation has the same final effect as running it once. A retry should return the existing result without charging again.

我为每个 follower 使用一个简单的 promise-based mutex。新的请求会排在这个 follower 的前一个请求后面，只有前一个请求释放锁后才能读取和修改状态。 ｜ I use a promise-based lock per follower. A new request waits for the previous request to finish before it reads or changes that follower.

锁是按 follower 分开的，因此 follower-1 被处理时不会阻塞 follower-2。函数还返回 copied、duplicate 或 rejected 三种明确状态，让调用方知道发生了成功、重复还是业务拒绝。 ｜ The lock is per follower, so different followers can still run in parallel. The result clearly says copied, duplicate, or rejected.

sections.title: Core Solution
points: Acquire the lock for this follower first.
Check the idempotency key before any balance change.
Reject disabled copying, invalid amounts, or insufficient funds.
Deduct balance and allocation in the same section.
Store the copy record before releasing the lock.
Return a cloned result so callers cannot mutate state.
speakingNotes: 处理开始时先进入该 follower 的锁。重点是锁必须包住读取状态的动作，而不只是包住最后的扣款；否则两个请求仍然可能同时读到同一个旧余额。 ｜ First, I acquire the lock for this follower. The lock must cover the state read as well as the update, or two requests could see the same old balance.

拿到锁以后，我先用 trade ID 和 follower ID 查记录。如果记录已经存在，就立即返回 duplicate，并返回之前的 follower 状态和 copy trade。这个分支不会碰余额、额度或记录。 ｜ Inside the lock, I check the idempotency key first. If a record exists, I return duplicate with the saved result and make no financial change.

如果不是重复请求，再验证四类条件：金额必须是有限的正数，follower 必须开启跟单，balance 要够，remainingAllocation 也要够。任何条件失败都会返回 rejected，并保留原来的状态。 ｜ For a new request, I validate four things: a finite positive amount, copying enabled, enough balance, and enough allocation. A failure returns rejected without changing state.

这些检查和更新都发生在同一个 critical section。也就是说，请求从读取 balance 开始，到写入记录结束，中间不能被另一个同 follower 请求插队；因此检查通过的余额就是实际扣减时的余额。 ｜ The checks and updates are one critical section. No other request for this follower can interrupt the flow between reading the balance and saving the result.

验证通过后，我分别从 balance 和 remainingAllocation 减去 trade amount，然后创建一条带有 sourceTradeId、traderId、followerId 和 amount 的记录。这样以后不仅知道扣了多少钱，也知道这笔跟单来自哪一笔源交易。 ｜ After validation, I reduce both limits and create a record with the source trade, trader, follower, and amount. The record explains exactly what was copied.

记录使用同一个 idempotency key 保存，并且在释放锁之前完成。如果同一 trade 紧接着重试，它一定能看到这条记录并走 duplicate 分支，而不是再次产生金融效果。 ｜ I save the record under the same idempotency key before releasing the lock. An immediate retry will therefore see it and become a duplicate.

返回结果时我使用 clone，而不是把内部 Map 里的对象直接暴露出去。这样调用方即使修改返回值，也不会偷偷改变服务内部保存的 balance 或记录。 ｜ I return cloned objects instead of internal references. A caller can inspect the result without being able to mutate the service state by accident.

所以关键顺序是：先排队拿锁，再查重复，再做资格校验，接着扣两个额度并保存记录，最后释放锁。这个顺序同时解决重复扣款和并发超支两个问题。 ｜ The order is lock, duplicate check, validation, two deductions, record, and unlock. This protects against both duplicate charges and concurrent overspending.

这张图把一次请求的主路径画出来。重复请求在记录检查处结束，不合格请求在校验处结束，只有通过校验的请求才会修改状态并返回 copied。 ｜ The diagram shows the three paths: duplicate stops at the record check, rejected stops at validation, and only a valid request changes state and returns copied.
sections.visual:
flowchart TD
  A[Copy trade request] --> B[Lock follower]
  B --> C{Record already exists?}
  C -- Yes --> D[Return duplicate]
  C -- No --> E{Eligible and enough funds?}
  E -- No --> F[Return rejected]
  E -- Yes --> G[Deduct balance]
  G --> H[Deduct allocation]

sections.title: Verification
points: Run the normal case with a 700 trade.
Send the same trade twice for one follower.
Start two different 700 trades at the same time.
Check final balance, allocation, and recorded trade count.
Test disabled copying, bad amounts, and low funds.
Use database transactions for multiple production workers.
speakingNotes: 第一个是正常场景：初始 balance 是 10,000，remainingAllocation 是 2,000，trade amount 是 700。请求应返回 copied，最终 balance 是 9,300，allocation 是 1,300，并且只保存一条金额为 700 的记录。 ｜ In the normal case, 10,000 and 2,000 become 9,300 and 1,300 after one 700 trade. The result is copied and there is one recorded trade.

第二个是同一笔 trade 重复发送。第一次请求会通过校验并返回 copied；第二次使用相同 key，会返回 duplicate。最终 balance 仍是 9,300，allocation 仍是 1,300，记录数量仍是一条。 ｜ In the retry case, the first call returns copied and the second returns duplicate. The final balance, allocation, and record count are exactly the same as after the first call.

第三个是并发场景：follower 只有 1,000 balance 和 1,000 allocation，同时收到两笔不同的 700。第一笔拿到锁并成功后只剩 300，第二笔重新读取状态时就会被拒绝。 ｜ In the concurrent case, two different 700 trades compete for 1,000. One succeeds, the balance becomes 300, and the second request is rejected after it reads the updated state.

代码使用 Promise.all 同时发起两个调用，而不是先后手动调用。demo 还会断言最终 balance 必须是 300，记录数量必须是一条；如果断言失败，程序会直接报错。 ｜ I use Promise.all to start both calls together. The demo asserts a final balance of 300 and exactly one record, so this is a behavioral check rather than only an explanation.

除了题目要求的三个场景，我还会检查 copying disabled、零金额、负金额、余额不足和 allocation 不足。每个拒绝场景都应该返回 rejected，不扣任何金额，也不留下 copy trade 记录。 ｜ I would also test disabled copying, zero or negative amounts, low balance, and low allocation. Every rejected request must leave both the amounts and the records unchanged.

这里的锁只保护一个 Node.js process，而且进程重启后内存数据会消失。所以 demo 证明的是单进程逻辑；如果部署多个 worker，就必须让数据库承担真正的原子性和唯一性保护。 ｜ This lock only protects one Node.js process, and memory disappears on restart. The demo proves the single-process logic; multiple workers need database protection.

sections.title: Wrap-up
points: The demo protects one follower from duplicate charges.
A per-follower lock prevents concurrent overspending.
PostgreSQL should own atomic updates in production.
speakingNotes: 总结一下，我构建了一个完整但有边界的 copy flow：它先判断 follower 是否 eligible，再在安全的顺序里扣掉 balance 和 allocation，最后记录成功的跟单交易，并把结果返回给调用方。 ｜ I built a small but complete copy flow. It checks eligibility, updates both limits safely, records the copy, and returns a clear result.

幂等 key 解决同一笔 trade 的重复请求，per-follower lock 解决单进程内多个请求竞争同一个 follower。它们分别保护“只处理一次”和“不能同时超支”这两个不变量。 ｜ The idempotency key protects the once-only rule, and the per-follower lock protects the no-overspending rule for concurrent requests.

如果接入 PostgreSQL，我会把检查、余额更新、allocation 更新和插入记录放在同一个 transaction 里。transaction 要么全部提交，要么全部回滚，因此不会出现扣了余额却没有交易记录的半完成状态。 ｜ With PostgreSQL, I would put the checks, both updates, and the insert in one transaction. It either commits all changes or rolls them all back.

同时，我会给 source trade ID 和 follower ID 建 UNIQUE constraint，并在 transaction 中使用 row-level lock 或条件更新锁住 follower 行。这样多个 production worker 也能共享同一套保护，而不是各自维护不一致的内存锁。 ｜ I would add a unique constraint on the source trade and follower IDs, and lock or conditionally update the follower row. That makes the protection work across production workers.
